summary: Tested the new business rules for anagrafica delete/archive/restore, the polizza delete block when a titolo has a Prima Nota movimento in a CLOSED day, and the puo_riaprire_giornate permission for reopening days, on both backend and frontend. Backend: 15/16 pytest pass. One HIGH bug: sinistri and allegati are never counted, so an anagrafica that only has sinistri gets PHYSICALLY DELETED instead of archived, leaving orphan sinistri. Frontend: everything requested works (Annullata badge + Ripristina, blocked dialog, archive via dialog, 'Può riaprire le giornate' checkbox persists). NOTE: the sandbox user test@sandbox.it does NOT exist in the preview DB (login 401, no user with 'sandbox' in users), so all tests ran in tenant principale with admin@assicura.it and TEST_-prefixed data.

critical.issue: Rule 2 (archive) does not detect sinistri: it counts db.sinistri by {'anagrafica_id': aid}, but the Sinistro model/DB only has 'contraente_id' (6417/6417 sinistri have contraente_id, 0 have anagrafica_id). Reproduced: anagrafica with one sinistro (contraente_id=aid) -> response {eliminata:true}, the anagrafica is physically deleted and the sinistro is left orphaned. Fix: count {'contraente_id': aid}.

Allegati are counted by {'anagrafica_id': aid}, but the allegati collection uses entita_tipo/entita_id (0/38 docs have anagrafica_id), so allegati are never detected. Collections diario, diario_cliente, diario_note and cloud_documents (matched_anagrafica_id) are also not checked. An anagrafica that only has allegati/diario notes is hard-deleted.

minor.issue: Missing numero_sinistro -> 500 Internal Server Error (pydantic ValidationError from Sinistro(**body) on a raw dict). It should return 422/400. This existed before this change.
When the anagrafica is hard-deleted, an empty analisi_cliente doc created by GET /analisi (_ensure_analisi) stays orphaned.

The new 'titolo in Prima Nota in a closed day' check is only reachable when the titolo is NOT incassato/coperto. Normal incasso/copertura paths are caught first by the older 409 'titoli incassati/coperti' check. Behaviour is correct, but the message the user sees is the older one.

Security: the body is a raw dict passed to $set. An admin can set any field (is_super_admin, role, token_valid_after...). Only agenzia_tenant_id, id and password_hash are stripped. This existed before this change; use a whitelist.

issues: The Ripristina (RotateCcw) and trash icons are text-slate-300 and hard to see until hover; the restore action is hard to discover.
There is no 'Annullate' filter: archived anagrafiche stay mixed into all lists and are only told apart by the badge. Consider a dedicated filter and excluding them by default.
At 1920px the table overflows horizontally: the Polizze, Premio and delete columns are cut off on first render.

action_items: Fix delete_anagrafica (routes/anagrafiche.py ~L896): count sinistri by contraente_id instead of anagrafica_id.

Fix delete_anagrafica (~L897): count allegati by entita_tipo='anagrafica' + entita_id=aid (check the actual entita_tipo value). Also consider diario, diario_cliente, diario_note and cloud_documents.matched_anagrafica_id.
On the hard-delete path, also delete the orphan analisi_cliente doc.
POST /api/sinistri: return 422 instead of 500 when numero_sinistro is missing.
Optional UX: add an 'Annullate' filter in Anagrafiche and improve the contrast of the restore icon.
Recreate the sandbox user test@sandbox.it in the preview DB, or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_anagrafica uses the field name anagrafica_id for every linked collection, but real schemas differ (sinistri.contraente_id, allegati.entita_id). Centralise a helper that maps each collection to its foreign key.
PUT /auth/users/{uid} accepts arbitrary fields (privilege escalation possible through is_super_admin).
server.py is about 19k lines and Librerie.jsx about 6.8k lines; both should be split.
test_credentials: test@sandbox.it / Test1234! FAILED (401; the user does not exist in the preview DB). Used admin@assicura.it / Admin123! (tenant-principale-schiantarelli).
seed_data_creation: TEST_DEL* and TESTUI* anagrafiche left in tenant principale (blocked ones cannot be deleted by design). A 2019-03-xx day was closed and then reopened (chiusure_giorno docs remain with riaperta_at). Temporary collaborator users and the test sinistro were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter_anag_delete_rules_riapri.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. It uses TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PWD env vars (default admin@assicura.it). test_archived_with_sinistro is expected to pass once delete_anagrafica counts sinistri by contraente_id. The closed-day polizza scenario is built with titolo + manual movimento (categoria=altro, titolo_id) on a 2019 date, then chiusura-giorno, and works.
rca of the issue: Repro: POST /api/anagrafiche, then POST /api/sinistri {contraente_id: aid, numero_sinistro: 'X'}, then DELETE /api/anagrafiche/{aid}. Result: 200 {eliminata:true} (expected archiviata:true). Root cause: routes/anagrafiche.py L896 uses db.sinistri.count_documents({'anagrafica_id': aid}), but the Sinistro model has no anagrafica_id (it uses contraente_id). The same mismatch on L897 affects allegati (entita_id).
